name: const unsafe fn byte_offset_from_unsigned < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : NonNull < U >) -> usize
rule: For safety, `self` must be equal to or greater than `origin`; for non-`Sized` pointees, this comparison considers only the data pointers, ignoring metadata.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn byte_offset_from_unsigned < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < U >) -> usize }
